extracted.name: Chai Tea Concentrate
extracted.description: Homemade chia tea concentrate is simple to prepare using a variety of spices steeped with black tea and brown sugar.
ingredient_lines: 8 (1/4 inch thick) slices unpeeled fresh ginger
instruction_lines: Bring water to a boil in a saucepan; add cloves and boil for 1 minute. Add cinnamon sticks, ginger, cardamom pods, peppercorns, and tea. Allow tea to steep for 6 minutes; strain into a container. Stir brown sugar and vanilla extract into tea and refrigerate until chilled, at least 1 hour.
